question:
Which of the given letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the following series to make it logically complete?

IHD 78 EDZ 87 AZV 96 WVR 105 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d38645cff1d6577356e8c4eb88a61c9c42a504a67b86fb8f12e1a4329954f72d.png] 

The logic followed here is that each letter in the cluster decreases by 4 in its alphabetical positional value, while the number increases by 9 in each step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d950b6b7874dbb0e6b178be4e797951d6e9e8bd0cdd15a2890dab5a8cf708d73.png]
